## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Each graduated gap produces exactly one memory entry with...

The system SHALL ensure that each graduated gap produces exactly one memory entry with source:transcript-mined, domain:, affected_skill, and at least one verbatim quote; a gap that is not graduated produces none.

#### Scenario: Each graduated gap produces exactly one memory entry with...

WHEN `emit-gap-ledger-as-transcript-mined-memory` is implemented
THEN Each graduated gap produces exactly one memory entry with source:transcript-mined, domain:, affected_skill, and at least one verbatim quote; a gap that is not graduated produces none.

### Requirement: Rerunning the emitter does not duplicate entries for already-emitted gaps...

The system SHALL ensure that rerunning the emitter does not duplicate entries for already-emitted gaps (idempotency test).

#### Scenario: Rerunning the emitter does not duplicate entries for already-emitted gaps...

WHEN `emit-gap-ledger-as-transcript-mined-memory` is implemented
THEN Rerunning the emitter does not duplicate entries for already-emitted gaps (idempotency test).

### Requirement: The improve-harness report generated from the emitted entries lists the...

The system SHALL ensure that the improve-harness report generated from the emitted entries lists the orchestration-domain gaps under affected_skill headings.

#### Scenario: The improve-harness report generated from the emitted entries lists the...

WHEN `emit-gap-ledger-as-transcript-mined-memory` is implemented
THEN The improve-harness report generated from the emitted entries lists the orchestration-domain gaps under affected_skill headings.
